cards.ex: She's perfected the cat-eye liner look; it always looks so flawless.
cards.exUz: U mushuk ko'zi linerini mukammal o'zlashtirgan; u har doim juda benuqson ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'z qovog'iga mushukning ko'zidek chizilgan chiziq.

cards.ex: That figure-hugging dress really shows off her curves.
cards.exUz: Bu qomatni ko'rsatadigan ko'ylak uning egri chiziqlarini chiroyli ko'rsatib beradi.
cards.uzDef: Qomatni ta'kidlaydigan, tanaga yopishib turadigan kiyim.

cards.ex: She swears by this youth-enhancing cream; she looks ten years younger.
cards.exUz: U yoshartiruvchi kremga qasam ichadi; u o'n yoshga yoshroq ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Yoshlikni saqlashga yoki ko'rinishini yaxshilashga yordam beradigan narsa.

cards.ex: Remember, beauty is only skin deep; what really matters is your personality.
cards.exUz: Unutmang, go'zallik faqat ustki qismidir; eng muhimi - sizning shaxsiyatingiz.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy go'zallik tashqi ko'rinish emas, balki ichki dunyoda ekanligini anglatadi.

cards.ex: He has a winning smile that can charm anyone.
cards.exUz: Uning har qanday odamni maftun eta oladigan dilni zabt etuvchi tabassumi bor.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarga yoqadigan va ishonch uyg'otadigan tabassum.

cards.ex: She always has a put-together look, even when she's just running errands.
cards.exUz: U har doim puxta o'ylangan ko'rinishga ega, hatto faqat topshiriqlarni bajarayotganda ham.
cards.uzDef: Mukammal va o'ziga xos ko'rinish.

cards.ex: She's been looking a picture of health since she started that new exercise regime.
cards.exUz: U yangi mashq rejimini boshlaganidan beri juda sog'lom ko'rinishga ega.
cards.uzDef: Juda sog'lom va kuchli ko'rinishga ega bo'lish, ya'ni sog'lig'i joyida.

cards.ex: She bears a striking resemblance to her mother when she was younger.
cards.exUz: U yoshligida onasiga juda o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Odam yoki narsa boshqa odam yoki narsaga o'xshash xususiyatlarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: He maintained a slim build despite his love of rich food.
cards.exUz: U mazali ovqatlarni yaxshi ko'rishiga qaramay, ingichka qomatini saqlab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Ozg'in va kelishgan tana tuzilishiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The restaurant has a strict dress code; no jeans or sneakers allowed.
cards.exUz: Restoranda qat'iy kiyinish qoidasi bor; jinsi shimlar yoki krossovkalar mumkin emas.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan vaziyat yoki joy uchun qabul qilingan kiyim uslubi qoidalari.

cards.ex: Some people just seem to age like wine, getting better with each passing year.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi odamlar vino kabi qarishadi, har yili yaxshilanib borishadi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan yaxshilanib, go'zalligini saqlab qolmoq.

cards.ex: He maintained a youthful appearance through diet and exercise.
cards.exUz: U parhez va mashqlar orqali yosh ko'rinishini saqlab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Yoshi kattaroq bo'lishiga qaramay, yoshga nisbatan yoshroq ko'rinish.

cards.ex: She's considered a classic beauty with her elegant features and poise.
cards.exUz: U o'zining nafis xususiyatlari va xushmuomalasi bilan klassik go'zallik hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Har doim go'zal va zamonaviy bo'lib qoladigan go'zallik turi.

cards.ex: He's a very good-looking man, with a charming smile.
cards.exUz: U juda chiroyli odam, jozibali tabassumga ega.
cards.uzDef: Tashqi ko'rinishi yoqimli, odamlarga yoqadigan.

cards.ex: She greeted me with a radiant smile that brightened my day.
cards.exUz: U meni kunimni yoritgan nurli tabassum bilan qarshi oldi.
cards.uzDef: Quvonch va baxtni ifodalovchi, juda yoqimli tabassum.

cards.ex: She has a flawless complexion that everyone envies.
cards.exUz: Uning benuqson terisi bor, unga hamma havas qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday nuqsoni yo'q, toza va silliq teri.

cards.ex: She decided to slim down before her wedding.
cards.exUz: U to'yidan oldin ozishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Vazn yo'qotish orqali qomatni ingichka qilish.

cards.ex: He goes to the gym regularly to build muscle.
cards.exUz: U mushaklarni qurish uchun muntazam ravishda sport zaliga boradi.
cards.uzDef: Mashqlar orqali mushak massasini oshirish.

cards.ex: He looked sharp with his fresh haircut and clean-shaven face.
cards.exUz: U yangi soch turmagi va toza soqoli bilan juda yaxshi ko'rinardi.
cards.uzDef: Yaqinda qilingan, yaxshi ko'rinadigan soch turmagi.

cards.ex: On weekends, I prefer to dress casually in jeans and a t-shirt.
cards.exUz: Dam olish kunlari men jinsi shimlar va futbolkada oddiy kiyinishni afzal ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy bo'lmagan, kundalik kiyimlar kiyish.

cards.ex: The event requires guests to dress formally in suits or evening gowns.
cards.exUz: Tadbir mehmonlardan kostyumlar yoki kechki liboslarda rasmiy kiyinishni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy tadbirlar uchun mos keladigan, nafis kiyimlar kiyish.

cards.ex: She takes pride in her appearance and always looks her best.
cards.exUz: U tashqi ko'rinishidan faxrlanadi va doimo eng yaxshi ko'rinishga ega bo'lishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yoki kimdir bilan faxrlanish, qadrlash.

cards.ex: She has a natural flair for fashion and always puts together amazing outfits.
cards.exUz: Uning modaga nisbatan tabiiy iste'dodi bor va doimo ajoyib kiyimlar yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishda tabiiy iste'dod yoki qobiliyatga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The actress was known for the beauty spot on her cheek.
cards.exUz: Aktrisa yuzidagi husn bug'i bilan mashhur edi.
cards.uzDef: Teridagi kichik, qora dog', ayniqsa, yuzda bo'lsa, go'zallik belgisi sifatida qabul qilinadi.

cards.ex: She has maintained a slender figure throughout her life.
cards.exUz: U butun umri davomida nozik qomatini saqlab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Ingichka va kelishgan tana tuzilishiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Her red dress made her stand out in the crowd.
cards.exUz: Uning qizil libosi uni olomon orasida ajralib turishiga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan farqli va ko'zga tashlanadigan bo'lish.

cards.ex: The statue was admired for its well-proportioned figure.
cards.exUz: Haykalning mutanosib qomati uchun maqtovga sazovor bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Tana qismlari bir-biriga mos va chiroyli ko'rinadigan.

cards.ex: He has a striking appearance with his tall stature and piercing blue eyes.
cards.exUz: U baland bo'yi va o'tkir ko'k ko'zlari bilan ajoyib ko'rinishga ega.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni tortadigan va esda qolarli tashqi ko'rinish.

cards.ex: She's considering going under the knife to reduce wrinkles.
cards.exUz: U ajinlarni kamaytirish uchun operatsiya qildirishni o'ylayapti.
cards.uzDef: Kosmetik jarrohlik amaliyotini o'tkazish.

cards.ex: She used creams to reduce the appearance of age spots on her hands.
cards.exUz: U qo'lidagi qarilik dog'lari ko'rinishini kamaytirish uchun kremlardan foydalangan.
cards.uzDef: Qarilik tufayli terida paydo bo'ladigan pigment dog'i.
